walkthrough.caption: Start a return for that open period.

walkthrough.headline: Box 1, VAT on sales
walkthrough.caption: Box 1 is the VAT due on your sales.

walkthrough.headline: Box 2, usually zero
walkthrough.caption: Box 2 is VAT on EU acquisitions, usually zero now.

walkthrough.headline: Box 3 adds it up
walkthrough.caption: Box 3 adds boxes 1 and 2 for you.

walkthrough.headline: Box 4, VAT reclaimed
walkthrough.caption: Box 4 is VAT you can reclaim on purchases.

walkthrough.headline: Box 5, the net total
walkthrough.caption: Box 5 works out what you owe overall.

walkthrough.headline: Box 6, total sales
walkthrough.caption: Box 6 is your total sales, without VAT.

walkthrough.headline: Box 7, total purchases
walkthrough.caption: Box 7 is your total purchases, without VAT.

walkthrough.headline: Boxes 8 and 9, EU trade
walkthrough.caption: Boxes 8 and 9 cover EU trade, usually zero now.

walkthrough.headline: Confirm the declaration
walkthrough.caption: Tick the declaration to confirm the return is accurate.

walkthrough.headline: Authorise again
walkthrough.caption: Submitting needs a wider grant, so HMRC asks once more. Sign in to HMRC and say yes again.

walkthrough.headline: Submitted
walkthrough.caption: HMRC confirms the return is filed. The receipt is your record that it went through.
